research_question: At every hybrid-policy residual reached from a 3CNF root, is there necessarily an exact-DP pivot whose transformed canonical state remains within the frozen root budget B=(C0+L0)*(V0+1)^2, or can a truth-blind adversarial search produce an explicit residual where every exact-DP pivot exceeds B?

known_theory_guard.reason: Zvi Galil, Theoretical Computer Science 4(1), 1977, DOI 10.1016/0304-3975(77)90054-8: infinitely many contradictory CNFs require 2^(c n) distinct clauses under the Davis-Putnam procedure for any variable-elimination order.
known_theory_guard.implication_for_TRUMP: Variable-count descent plus exact DP alone cannot justify a universal polynomial theorem. Any universal rescue must prove that the hybrid R33/RUP/SA-BVE/affine stack excludes or collapses the classical hard fill-in regime before polynomial state bounds fail.

analytic_pivot_upper_bound.purpose: Polynomial-time sufficient certificate that an exact-DP pivot fits B without relying on post-hoc exact transformed size.

definitions.SP: sum of lengths of +x parent clauses
definitions.SN: sum of lengths of -x parent clauses

analytic_pivot_upper_bound.validity_reason: Every raw non-tautological resolvent is generated from one positive/negative parent pair and has length at most (|P|-1)+(|N|-1); tautology deletion, duplicate elimination and strict-subsumption normalization can only decrease the exact canonical size relative to this bound.
analytic_pivot_upper_bound.certificate: UB_S <= B implies exact canonical DP state size <= B

frozen_AA_domain.Z_replay: all 15 X residual roots plus Y minimized core, preserving their inherited root budgets

behavior_guided_mutations.parent_selection: solver-structure-only; rank residuals by smallest best analytic budget slack, never by SAT truth

structured_controls: existing XOR/Tseitin controls remain controls because affine recognition may pre-empt DP
no exact truth is used for generation, ranking, pivot selection or verdict

deterministic_policy_under_test.first: run frozen W hybrid policy until terminal/affine/residual
deterministic_policy_under_test.on_residual: enumerate every exact-DP pivot with independent replay
deterministic_policy_under_test.admissible: variable count strictly decreases and exact canonical C+L <= inherited B
deterministic_policy_under_test.chosen: lexicographically minimize (C_after, L_after, var) exactly as Z
deterministic_policy_under_test.restart: run frozen W hybrid policy again

counterexample_classes.NO_EXACT_DP_PIVOT_AT_RESIDUAL: residual has no variable occurring in both polarities / no exact-DP record
counterexample_classes.ALL_EXACT_DP_PIVOTS_EXCEED_ROOT_BUDGET: every independently replayed exact-DP transformed canonical state has C+L > inherited B
counterexample_classes.RESIDUAL_AFTER_AT_MOST_V0_FALLBACKS: hybrid+DP scheduler still residual after V0 variable-decreasing fallback steps
counterexample_classes.STATE_BUDGET_VIOLATION: current state already exceeds inherited B
